fields.AN_Notes: Edited volume with introduction, field chapters and outlook; codes cover the volume as one Work. Studientyp Theoretisch for the predominantly conceptual chapters; the volume also contains one mixed-method prototype study with usability tests (Plafky et al.) and one demonstration of text-analysis techniques on a synthetic case (Holz et al.). AN_Prompting_Role: Learning_Content from Beranek ('Kommunikative Kompetenzen wie Prompting (zum Bedienen von KI)'), Recommended_Practice from the structured instruction template of the Aktennotiz prototype (Plafky et al., Tabelle 1); the prompting attacks in Pelzl are a security risk description and were not coded as Object_of_Critique. General_Guidance strategy verbatim: 'Basierend auf realen und erfundenen Aktennotizen wurde die KI nach einer konkreten Struktur instruiert' (Tabelle 1: Strukturvorgabe für die KI-Anwendung). AN_Bias_Axes: each axis is a worked example in a chapter's own argument (Amazon hiring and Beranek's gender examples; Dutch child-benefit case for families with migration history and the bias-audit example; Allegheny poverty example; Schlomann on age discrimination; Steiner on disability and inclusion; BIPoC example and ethnic disadvantage in the AFST evaluation). Intersectional not coded: the BIPoC-women versus white-men comparison is cited and shows no result that depends on the combination. Sexual orientation and queer people appear only in single mentions or enumerations. AN_Harm_Types: only Exclusionary_Norms rests on the editors' own argument that clients deviate from the norm dominating internet training data; Indirect_Discrimination (Allegheny proxy), Direct_Discrimination (Dutch case), Stereotyping (UNESCO images, age stereotypes) and Disparate_Performance (Gender Shades) occur only as cited cases and stay uncoded under rule 1.4.1. AN_Mitigation_Status Proposed: data analysis, exclusion or synthetic data, diverse developer teams, ethics boards, bias audit, AI literacy training and human-in-the-loop are recommended; the AFST evaluation in Steiner (reduced ethnic disadvantage, Goldhaber-Fiebert/Prince 2019) is cited for a decision-support tool, not for a bias mitigation, and does not raise the status. AN_Gender_Definition Absent and AN_Gender_Understanding Unclear: gender appears only in brief discrimination examples and the digital gender gap of older people with women and men named, without any determination of gender; the volume's gender-inclusive language is not an analysis category. AN_Theory_Reference: Steiner frames AI-related under-representation and exclusion through a critical conception of inclusion and exclusion (Luhmann, Stichweh, Rojas); Staub-Bernasconi, Media Equation Theory and CASA frame ethics or communication, not gender or bias. Feministisch nein: no feminist theory or methodology and no structural gender critique; Steiner mentions intersectional aspects only as a development requirement.
